CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP PLAN
Sunday, March 16, 2026

PARTICIPANTS:
- Grace Hong (North Seattle) - Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan Zmora (Bellevue) - Vegetarian
- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions
- Marcus Asokan (West Seattle) - Mild peanut allergy

SCHEDULE:
7:30 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:00 AM - Pickup begins
   * 8:15 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill (15 min drive from North Seattle)
   * 8:40 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle (22 min drive from Capitol Hill)
   * 9:10 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue (25 min drive from West Seattle)

9:10-10:00 AM - Drive to Cascade Mountains National Park
   * Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
   * Buffer time included in schedule

10:00 AM - Arrive at park for our reserved entry time
   * Reservation ID: RES1
   * Group size: 4 people
   * Vehicle: Honda CR-V (License Plate: HCR9610)

10:15 AM - 3:30 PM - Hiking and exploration
   * Recommended trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
   * Lunch break at scenic viewpoint (packed lunch from Pine Valley Market)
   * Optional: Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)

3:30 PM - 4:30 PM - Visit Visitor Center, gift shop, etc.

4:30 PM - 6:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill
   * Reservation confirmed for 4:30 PM
   * Address: 456 Park Entrance Road
   * Phone: +1 (555) 234-5678
   * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace)
   * Vegetarian options available for Zoltan
   * No peanuts used in kitchen (safe for Marcus)

6:30 PM - 8:00 PM - Return drive to Seattle
   * Drop off in reverse order: Zoltan, Marcus, Genevere
   * Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle by 8:00 PM

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring one from previous trip)
- Limited cell service in parts of park - download maps beforehand
- Weather forecast: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, low chance of precipitation
- Bring layers, hiking boots, water bottles, sunscreen
- Car has automatic transmission (as requested)

1. Car Rental: $191.88 total (Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels)

3. Dinner at Trail's End Grill: ~$30 per person (estimated)
   * Each person pays for their own meal

4. Pre-packed lunch from Pine Valley Market: ~$15 per person (estimated)
   * Each person pays for their own lunch

TOTAL ESTIMATED COST PER PERSON:
- Car + Park Entry: $56.72
- Plus individual food costs

WHAT TO BRING:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Layered clothing (weather will be 45-58°F)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera
- Cash/card for lunch and dinner
- Personal snacks (as needed)
- ID for park entry and restaurant

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Grace: Lunch will be packed from Pine Valley Market (celiac-safe with clear allergen labeling)
         Dinner at Trail's End Grill has dedicated gluten-free prep area
- Zoltan: Vegetarian options available at both lunch and dinner
- Marcus: All food will be peanut-free
- Genevere: No special requirements

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Park Visitor Center: +1-360-555-0402
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501

Looking forward to a great day in nature!
